# Production-ready orders CSV export

**Size:** L · **Ticket:** none · **Opened:** 2026-11-13

## What
Make `exportOrdersCsv` (src/routes/orders.js) stream rows instead of building one string, quote fields per
RFC 4180 (comma, double quote, CR/LF) in both header and rows, and add a `since` date filter.

## Why
Prod has ~200k orders; building the whole file in memory is wasteful. Unquoted fields with commas/quotes/
newlines corrupt the file. The mobile app parses this export.

## Done when
- [ ] `exportOrdersCsv` yields the CSV incrementally (header, then one row at a time), never the whole file as one string
- [ ] Fields containing `,`, `"`, CR or LF are wrapped in double quotes with inner `"` doubled, in rows and header
- [ ] `since` filter returns only orders at or after the given instant
- [ ] Output for data without special characters is byte-identical to today's (LF separators, no trailing newline, same columns/order, `Total` as `fmt(cents)`) (derived: mobile compatibility)
- [ ] Tests cover quoting, header quoting, streaming, `since`, and compatibility; `node --test` passes (derived)
- [ ] `src/routes/orders.js` parses again (derived: currently a SyntaxError at line 21)

## Constraints
- CLAUDE.md: ESM only, no dependencies, keep functions pure, tests use node:test.
- Mobile app compatibility: no change to separators, line endings, column set or order, unless the user approves.

## Edge cases
| Case | In scope? | Covered by |
|---|---|---|
| Field with comma / quote / LF / CR / CRLF | yes | T1 |
| Header label with special chars | yes | T1 |
| Field that is only a quote, or empty string | yes | T1 |
| null/undefined field → empty | yes | T2 |
| 0 orders → header only, no trailing newline | yes | T2 |
| 200k orders, consumer reads lazily | yes | T2 + T3 |
| `since` boundary (equal instant included) | yes | T2 |
| `since` as Date or ISO string; invalid `since` throws | yes | T2 |
| Order missing/invalid `createdAt` when `since` given → excluded | yes | T2 |
| Time zones: compare instants (ms since epoch), not local dates | yes | T2 |
| Non-ASCII (é, emoji) passes through unchanged | yes | T1 |
| CSV/formula injection (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@` prefixes) | no | findings.md (would change format) |
| `total` null → `NaN` from `fmt` | no | findings.md (existing behavior) |
| `db.orders` as async DB cursor | no | findings.md |
| CRLF line endings per RFC 4180 | no | decisions.md (mobile compat) |
